🔒 Privacy & Security

Privacy Policy

At XamlTech we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This page explains clearly and simply how your data is collected, used and protected across all our services.

1. Introduction and scope

This Privacy Policy applies to all digital services provided by XamlTech, based in Aswan, Arab Republic of Egypt, including:

  • The website xamltech.com and all of its pages.
  • ERP, HR, payroll, medical and accounting systems.
  • AI assistants, AI agents and semantic search (RAG).
  • The addons store and Android (APK) download requests.
  • Android applications published by the company, such as Network Copilot.
  • Contact forms, quote and demo requests, and WhatsApp correspondence.

By using any of these services you agree to this policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

2. Data we collect

Data you provide directly:

  • Name, email and phone number when you submit a contact form or request a demo.
  • Your name, email, device details and request reason when submitting an APK download request.
  • Account and profile data when you use our internal systems.

Data we collect automatically:

  • Usage data: pages you visit, visit duration, links you click.
  • Technical data: browser type, operating system, device type, approximate IP address.
  • Security logs: login attempts and access points used to protect the systems.

3. Sensitive data

We do not collect sensitive data (such as health, religious, or other special-category data) unless you are a government organisation or an entity that has engaged us for such data.

4. Sources of data

  • Directly from you: through forms, correspondence and requests.
  • Automatically: via analytics and logging when you use the website.
  • From third parties: where legally required (e.g. authentication services) and with your consent or legal authorisation.

5. How we use your data

  • To provide the services you requested and perform our contracts with you.
  • To process app-download requests and enable secure download links.
  • To improve and personalise the experience and content.
  • To contact you about your requests, our offers and support.
  • To protect the systems and detect fraudulent or unauthorised activity.
  • To comply with Egyptian legal and accounting obligations.

6. Legal basis for processing

We process your data on the following bases, in line with Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 and its executive regulations:

  • Consent: when you voluntarily provide your data through forms and requests.
  • Performance of a contract: to provide the services and products you engage us for.
  • Legal obligation: to comply with tax, accounting and governmental legislation.
  • Legitimate interest: to improve services and protect system security, balancing our interest against your rights.

7. Cookies

We use cookies and similar technologies to:

  • Operate the website (login session, form protection).
  • Store your preferences (dark/light mode, language).
  • Measure performance and analytics in aggregate, without identifying individuals.

You can manage or delete cookies from your browser settings at any time; some settings may affect website functionality.

8. Data sharing and disclosure

We do not sell or rent your personal data to any party. We may share your data only in the following cases:

  • Technical service providers: hosting, analytics, mailing, payment gateways — under contracts that ensure confidentiality.
  • AI providers: only when you use the AI assistant and explicitly invoke an external provider, and under that provider's terms.
  • Government bodies: when Egyptian law or a court order requires it.

9. Storage and security

  • Data is encrypted in transit using HTTPS and TLS.
  • Sensitive data and secrets (such as download-link keys) are stored encrypted or as secure derivatives (HMAC).
  • App download links are temporary, expiring (30 days) and unpredictable.
  • Access rights follow least privilege, with immutable audit logs.
  • Periodic backups with tested recovery policies.

Despite all measures, absolute security of any internet transmission cannot be guaranteed; we undertake to report any breach promptly and to the extent required by law.

10. Data retention

  • Accounting data and contracts: as required by Egyptian law.
  • Download requests and chat logs: deleted once the purpose ends or upon your request.
  • Aggregated analytics data: for a period not exceeding one year.

When the purpose ends, we delete the data or make it non-identifiable.

11. Your rights

Under Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020, you have the right to:

  • Access your data and verify its accuracy.
  • Request correction or updating of your data.
  • Request suspension, restriction or deletion of processing where legally provided.
  • Withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
  • Object to processing for marketing purposes.
  • File a complaint with Egypt's National Personal Data Protection Centre.

You can exercise any of these rights by emailing info@xamltech.com; we will respond within no more than 30 days.

12. Android apps and APK download requests

  • Network Copilot: network diagnostics (IP, MAC, SSID, DNS, ping, scanning) are performed entirely on your device and do not leave it unless you export or share results yourself.
  • App downloads (APK): when you request a download, we collect your name and email (optionally your phone, Android version and request context) to issue a secure, expiring link.
  • Beta builds upload anonymous crash reports through tools (Firebase) to help stability, without images or personal content.

13. AI and semantic search

  • Your query is processed within our systems to answer your question and is not used to build an independent profile of you.
  • If you choose an external (cloud) AI provider, a brief prompt is sent to that provider under its terms; you can choose a local provider (Ollama) to keep data inside your environment.
  • We keep a conversation log to power the multi-turn "memory" feature; you can delete it from the assistant UI at any time.
  • We do not use your questions to train external models without explicit consent.

14. Children

Our services are intended for organisations, companies and professionals, and we do not knowingly collect data from persons under 18. If we learn we have collected such data, we delete it immediately.

15. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time to keep pace with service developments or legal requirements. On a material change we update the "last updated" date and announce the change on this page.

16. Contact us

For any enquiry, to exercise your rights or to file a complaint:

  • Email: info@xamltech.com
  • Location: Aswan, Arab Republic of Egypt

Glossary

  • Personal data: any data that identifies you directly or indirectly.
  • Processing: any operation on data, from collection and storage to use, sharing and deletion.
  • HMAC: a cryptographic signing technique that ensures the integrity of a download link and prevents tampering.
  • National Personal Data Protection Centre: the Egyptian regulator tasked with enforcing Law No. 151 of 2020.
